title: $0 Revenue, a $1 Billion Projection: Inside the Theranos Pitch

lines.say: According to prosecutors, Theranos had zero revenue in two thousand twelve and two thousand thirteen.
lines.show: According to prosecutors, Theranos had zero revenue in 2012 and 2013.

lines.say: Investors were shown projections of one hundred forty million dollars for two thousand fourteen, and nearly one billion for two thousand fifteen.
lines.show: Investors were shown projections of $140 million for 2014, and nearly $1 billion for 2015.

lines.say: In November two thousand thirteen, the appeals court noted, Theranos was down to fifteen million dollars in cash, spending up to two million a week.
lines.show: In November 2013, the appeals court noted, Theranos was down to $15 million in cash, spending up to $2 million a week.

lines.say: One investor was told Theranos had earned over two hundred million dollars from the military and drug companies. Prosecutors said it never earned more than ten million from both.
lines.show: One investor was told Theranos had earned over $200 million from the military and drug companies. Prosecutors said it never earned more than $10 million from both.

lines.say: The judge later ordered four hundred fifty-two million dollars in restitution to investors.
lines.show: The judge later ordered $452 million in restitution to investors.

lines.say: Real trials. Real evidence. The verdict.
